summary: Block gsc rg/query/notes/rules unless the required guide was loaded earlier in the session.

changelog.message: Changed topic from agent-lifecycle-rules to tool-gates for better discoverability
Expanded to cover gsc rg, gsc notes, and gsc rules in addition to gsc query
Expanded command_filter to match gsc rg/query/notes/rules; updated instruction with per-command guide requirements

instruction.text: Before using `gsc rg`, load `gsc experts guide visualization`. Before `gsc query`, load `gsc experts guide query`. Before `gsc notes`, load `gsc experts guide notes`. Before `gsc rules`, load `gsc experts guide rules`.

summary: Prefer gsc rg over broad plain rg when Brains are active.
details: Blocks broad repository discovery commands that start with plain `rg` when active GitSense Brains can enrich search results. Allows targeted known-file line lookups, `rg --files`, temp-path searches, parse failures, and Brain discovery failures.

instruction.text: For broad repository discovery, prefer `gsc rg <pattern> --db <brain> --fields purpose` when active Brains are available. Use `gsc rg <pattern> --db <brain> --summary` for aggregate match/file counts. Plain `rg` is acceptable for targeted line lookup in known individual files.
